description: This file defines a function that constructs a provider-owned replay policy specifically for Anthropic transports within the OpenClaw framework. It imports types and helper functions from the plugin SDK and exports a single function that builds the replay policy based on a model ID.

methods.name: export function buildAnthropicReplayPolicy(ctx: ProviderReplayPolicyContext): ProviderReplayPoli/ buildAnthropicReplayPolicy
methods.description: Constructs and returns a replay policy for Anthropic models using the provided context.
